verdict.rationale: Docs state that every SDK shares the same identity model so a user instrumented once is understood everywhere, implying cross-device identity resolution, but there is no explicit mention of merging anonymous pre-signup activity into an identified profile (e.g., identify/alias APIs) in the pack. missing for 10: explicit documentation of user merge/alias API for anonymous-to-identified transition, cross-device identity resolution details, and independent/hands-on confirmation.
